events.what: Broe proves the Tate conjecture for abelian fourfolds over finite fields
Li extends Broe's result to abelian fivefolds over finite fields
Guo–Yang largely complete the Tate conjecture for surfaces of geometric genus one
Milne shows the integral Tate conjecture fails for very general abelian varieties
Zenodo 'constructive spectral proof' of the full Tate conjecture
events.credibility_reason: F5: same author posted dozens of similar 'proofs' (RH, Hodge, P≠NP, Goldbach, BSD, theories of everything) on a self-publishing repository; no uptake; landmark problem; method not an established approach.

events.what: ProofAtlas research map of the Tate conjecture

judgement.doubts: Broe, Li and Guo–Yang are all case-level settlements at the same tier; all human, so ai_role none either way. Credited humans list includes Milne, whose result is a variant; left as is since it records human credit for context.

corrections.why: F1: the record itself calls Broe's fourfold result 'a genuine restriction of the stated question (a case, not a variant)'; an unreviewed case is partial, not claimed. The only whole-scope claim (Zenodo) is not credible, as the summary argues.
